1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kualiti Alam Sekeliling

(Pewakilan Kuasa kepada Jabatan Kerajaan, Pihak Berkuasa Tempatan dan

Perbadanan) 2025.

Pewakilan kuasa

2. Ketua Pengarah mewakilkan kuasanya di bawah seksyen 31, 37, 37A, 37C, 38, 38A,

38AB, 45, 47, 48AC dan 48B Akta kepada pegawai yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (3) Jadual

dari Jabatan Kerajaan, pihak berkuasa tempatan atau perbadanan yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (2) Jadual untuk menguatkuasakan kesalahan yang dinyatakan dalam

ruang (4) Jadual.

Pembatalan

3. Perintah yang berikut dibatalkan:

(a) Perintah Kualiti Alam Sekeliling (Perwakilan Kuasa Kawalan Pencemaran

Marin) 1993 [P.U. (A) 276/1993];

Marin) 1994 [P.U. (A) 537/1994];

Pembakaran Terbuka) 2000 [P.U. (A) 311/2000];

Kawalan Hakisan dan Kelodakan) 2012 [P.U. (A) 436/2012].

ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT 1974

ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY (DELEGATION OF POWERS TO GOVERNMENT

DEPARTMENT, LOCAL AUTHORITY AND CORPORATION) ORDER 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 49(1) of the

Environmental Quality Act 1974 [Act 127], the Director General makes

the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Environmental Quality (Delegation of Powers

to Government Department, Local Authority and Corporation) Order 2025.

Delegation of powers

2. The Director General delegates his powers under sections 31, 37, 37A, 37C, 38, 38A,

38AB, 45, 47, 48AC and 48B of the Act to officers specified in column (3) of the Schedule

from the Government Department, local authority or corporation specified in column (2)

of the Schedule to enforce the offences specified in column (4) of the Schedule.

Revocation

3. The following Orders are revoked:

(a) Environmental Quality (Delegation of Powers on Marine Pollution Control)

Order 1993 [P.U. (A) 276/1993];

(b) Environmental Quality (Delegation of Powers on Marine Pollution Control)

Order 1994 [P.U. (A) 537/1994];

(c) Environmental Quality (Delegation of Powers) (Investigation of Open

Burning) Order 2000 [P.U. (A) 311/2000];

(d) Environmental Quality (Delegation of Powers) (Halon Management)

Order 2000 [P.U. (A) 490/2000];

(e) Environmental Quality (Delegation of Powers) (Perbadanan Putrajaya)

Order 2002 [P.U. (A) 233/2002]; and

(f) Environmental Quality (Delegation of Powers) (Investigation on Erosion

and Sediment Control) Order 2012 [P.U. (A) 436/2012].
